chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Hilāl narrated from ʿUqbah ibn Khālid, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Among the rulings of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was: “The mine entails no liability, the well entails no liability, and the animal entails no liability.”

key_terms.الْعَجْمَاءَ: an animal, especially one without speech
key_terms.قَضَاءِ النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet’s legal judgment or ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the Prophet’s ruling on liability for harm caused by a mine, a well, or an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله concerning cases in which harm occurs through a mine, a well, or an animal. The term جُبَارٌ indicates the absence of compensatory liability in such cases within the legal context of the report.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5344 - Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Among the rulings of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) was:
'There is no liability (Jubar) for injuries caused by a mine, a well, or an animal.'"
